rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEZcanary
Exhibition name: Canary Diamond ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by O.L. Weeks (1912-2002) (United States, 2002).
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2003 as 'Canary Diamond'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Moderate fragrance. 17 to 25 petals. Average diameter 4". Medium, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Large, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 5' (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
